naming: The loader builds its YamlDotNet IDeserializer with CamelCaseNamingConvention + IgnoreUnmatchedProperties. A C# PascalCase property binds to the camelCase YAML key. The 'direction' enum is parsed case-insensitively.

keys.description: The flow's unique identifier; seeds the stable FlowId. A blank value fails: "'name' is required for an sftp flow."
Optional grouping label recorded with the run.
Which way files move: down from the server into local (default), or up to the server from local.
The SFTP server and its credentials.
The SFTP host name or IP.
The SFTP username (a coordinate, not a secret).
A ${...} reference to the password; an alternative to server.privateKeyRef. One of the two is required.
A ${...} reference to the private-key PEM.
A ${...} reference to the passphrase protecting server.privateKeyRef.
The non-SFTP side: a data-lake URI (abfss://…/https) or a local/UNC path. On download it is the target; on upload it is the source. Managed-identity authenticated for Azure.
The directory on the SFTP server (the remote root). On download it is listed; on upload it is written to.
File-name glob selecting which files transfer.
Recurse into subdirectories under the root.
Only transfer files modified within this many days; 0 = all.
Overwrite an existing destination file; when false a collision fails rather than clobbers.
